summary.text: Cecil Thomas is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 25 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired Cincinnati police officer, he previously served in the Ohio State Senate from 2015 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Cecil Thomas was born in Alabama and lives in North Avondale, Ohio, according to Ballotpedia.
He graduated from Withrow High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Cincinnati.
His career experience includes 27 years with the Cincinnati Police Department, and after retiring from the department he worked as executive director of the Cincinnati Human Relations Commission.
Thomas served in the Ohio State Senate, District 9, from 2015 to 2022, and he was ranking member of the Senate Judiciary Committee during the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions.
He assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on January 1, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Veterans and Military Development, House Local Government and Public Safety committees, and is the ranking member of the Public Safety Committee.
